name: LLMTabBench
description: Supervised classification on tabular data remains a central machine learning task, but its dependence on large labeled datasets limits its applicability in data-scarce settings. Few-shot methods such as TabPFN achieve strong performance through large-scale synthetic pretraining, yet still require labeled context examples. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a more flexible alternative through zero- and few-shot in-context learning from task descriptions, but their behavior on tabular data remains inconsistent.
